description: Short-range molecular dynamics with cell-list decomposition. Computes Lennard-Jones type particle interactions within neighboring cells (26 neighbors + self = 27 cells per box) on an NxNxN grid of boxes. Emits per-iteration kernel times; GFLOPS is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: num_boxes
scaling_param.description: Number of boxes per dimension (total boxes = N^3)

non_scaling_params.name: particles_per_box
non_scaling_params.description: Number of particles in each box
